Asset: Empire game C01-CH02-S06, White River night crossing, a finished opaque narrative illustration. Create one full-bleed landscape image, preferably 1672 x 941 pixels, nearly 16:9.
Reference roles: Images 1-3 are ONLY approved art-direction references. Match their chunky hand-painted cartoon fantasy forms, thick clean dark contours, broad matte cel-like color planes, clear big silhouettes, restrained detail and elevated three-quarter view. Do not copy their locations or named characters. Image 4 is the exact original topic cell: retain its night river evacuation identity, timber refugee rafts, rope-assisted crossing, anonymous bundled civilians, helper soldiers, cold water, rocky forest banks and horses on land. Recompose this whole topic into a wide coherent scene rather than stretching the square.
Scene: deep-winter night on the White River, blue moonlit water flowing between rocky conifer banks. Small patches of cold pale ground and sparse dry reeds; no blizzard. A moon in the upper background. The action is a practical evacuation rather than combat or triumph. Two readable low timber rafts, one near center and one a little farther back, carry hooded noncombatants and a bundled injured person. A helper escort balances in each raft; two rope guide lines run coherently bank-to-bank with their shore anchor posts visible, and land-based soldiers pull them to help the rafts cross. One or two other escorts wade only in the shallow reed margin. A small horse and a modest grain cart remain visibly on the bank, separated from the shallow walking route. People, horses and wheels must not be submerged or fused.
Composition: landscape elevated storybook view; keep the foremost raft, cold river and helping action within the middle third so a center portrait cover crop still tells the crossing story. Both banks frame the full scene. Clear foreground/midground/background depth, ample visual breathing room. About a dozen simplified anonymous figures total, not a mass of tiny dots. Their faces and clothing do not impersonate any named protagonist. Foot soldiers use simple muted blue-gray practical armor and cloaks; civilian coats are warm brown/taupe.
Lighting/palette: dark teal conifers and slate boulders, cool blue water with a FEW broad moon-reflection shapes, muted warm brown raft timber, just one small warm shore lantern. Clearly night but subjects readable at 256x144. Shape shading is matte and broad, not shiny.
Constraints: one complete opaque RGB scene, no cutout or transparent-sprite look, no white background, no borders, no UI. No generated words, letters, numbers, labels or watermarks. No heraldry, no flag, no invented named identities. Do not copy the source's dense tiny stones, white water speckles, numerous stars or repetitive texture. No glossy highlights, no realistic rendering, no micro-texture, no dense surface flecks. Keep water, ground and trees as broad simple forms.
